test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

__I__ stayed __in__ my hometown __with__ my parents __on__ the pandemic.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the preposition "**on**" before "the pandemic".
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is "**during**", indicating the time period when the action took place.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**during the pandemic**", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part A** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I stayed in my hometown with my parents **during **the pandemic."*
